sourceContributions.boundary: Source-native NASA rows attached by exact NASA names and identifiers only. Aliases are cross-identifiers, not independent confirmation; alternative stellar, transit and microlensing solutions are separate publication rows and are never averaged.

nasa-name-tables.note: keplernames/k2names rows attached as aliases by exact pl_name or KOI designation.

nasa-stellar-hosts.note: Each publication-specific stellarhosts row attaches to every NASA PS planet whose host name it names exactly, and to TOI candidates on the same TIC star; parameter sets are never merged.

nasa-transiting-planets.note: TD publication rows attach to the NASA PS planet with exactly the same pl_name.

nasa-microlensing.note: Microlensing solutions (including degenerate models) attach to the NASA PS planet with exactly the same pl_name; no preferred model is chosen.

nasa-atmospheric-spectroscopy.note: Spectrum metadata rows (type, instrument, wavelength range, reference) attach to the NASA PS planet with exactly the same pl_name; spectra are not reinterpreted as detections.

scientificBoundary: Static public catalog projection. Source membership is not independent confirmation; source-composite values are not self-consistent publication solutions; catalog projections are not completeness-corrected populations.
